mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_order_fulfillment(tenant_id,order_id,fulfillment_no,source_actor_key,source_request_id,delivery_ref,delivered_at,delivery_hash,created_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{order},#{number},#{actor},#{event},#{evidence},#{at},#{hash},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_order_fulfillment.id
mapper.select: SELECT fulfillment_no,order_id,delivery_hash,delivered_at,completion_hash,completed_at,version FROM tc_order_fulfillment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_order SET status='FULFILLING',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{order} AND version=#{version} AND status='PAID'

UPDATE tc_order_fulfillment SET completion_actor_key=#{actor},completion_request_id=#{event},completion_ref=#{evidence},completed_at=#{at},completion_hash=#{hash},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND version=#{version} AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE tc_order SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{at},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{order} AND version=#{version} AND status='FULFILLING' AND completed_at IS NULL
